name: Media Types
abstract: Media types and profile identifiers of OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core (DRAFT, OGC 18-062r3).
description:
JSON media types that would typically be used in a server that supports JSON are: - `application/json` for all resources. The typical HTML media type for all “web pages” in a server would be: - `text/html`. The media type for an OpenAPI 3.0 definition is `application/vnd.oai.openapi+json;version=3.0` (JSON) or `application/vnd.oai.openapi;version=3.0` (YAML). **NOTE:** The OpenAPI media types have not yet been registered with IANA and may change in the future. As previously mentioned in the [“Content negotiations by profile”](#sec-7.7) clause, in some circumstances the use of generic media types, such as `application/json`, is too ambiguous. To more specifically identify responses generated by a server compliant with this Standard, the following profile URIs are defined: **Table 14 — Profile identifiers**
Profile URIDescription
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/ogc-process-listA JSON-encoded document that contains a list of processes offered by a server.
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/ogc-process-descriptionA JSON-encoded OGC process description as defined in Requirements Class “OGC Process Description”.
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/ogc-execute-requestA JSON-encoded document that contains an execute request.
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/jobs-listA JSON-encoded document that contains a list of jobs.
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/job-descriptionA JSON-encoded document that contains status information about a job.
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/ogc-resultsA JSON document that contains processing results (results.yaml).
https://www.opengis.net/def/profile/OGC/0/ogc-collectionA document representation of the Collection Output resulting from a Process Execution.
